deviations: entities need an owner scope: NewTextSelectionHandle takes one; TextSelectionLayer keeps the window state alive through a keyed holder entity
the participant content mask is recorded via gpui.ContentMask(w) at registration (Hitbox's mask is unexported); a recover guard makes it a no-op outside a draw
text_rows_extent uses the caret after the last character (TextLayout exposes no line layouts); still a covering extent
Subscribe is a self-subscription on the participant; touch observation goes through an observer entity (no App-level subscribe/observe)
